select id, order_no, asset_id, asset_code, asset_name, compensation_status, created_at from loss_order
compensation_status = #{compensationStatus}
and order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
and asset_code like concat('%', #{assetCode}, '%')
and asset_name like concat('%', #{assetName}, '%')
and category_name like concat('%', #{categoryName}, '%')
and responsible_user_name like concat('%', #{responsibleUserName}, '%')
and responsible_user_employee_no like concat('%', #{responsibleUserEmployeeNo}, '%')
and responsible_department_name like concat('%', #{responsibleDepartmentName}, '%')
and created_at >= #{startDate}
and created_at <= #{endDate}
